dirac-rac.name: DiRAC resource allocation calls
dirac-rac.summary: The calls of the UK's DiRAC HPC facility for theoretical astronomy, particle and nuclear physics, allocated by its Resource Allocation Committee.

doe-alcc.name: ASCR Leadership Computing Challenge
doe-alcc.organization: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science
doe-alcc.summary: The annual ALCC call for time on the DOE leadership computing facilities, for work of high priority to the DOE mission.

esrf-beamtime.name: ESRF beamtime proposals
esrf-beamtime.summary: Beamtime at a synchrotron: standard proposals reviewed by panels twice a year, and a rolling route for rapid access.

eurohpc-ju-access.name: EuroHPC JU access calls
eurohpc-ju-access.summary: The access calls of the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking: allocations on the EuroHPC supercomputers, AI Factories and quantum computers, from short benchmark and development access to peer-reviewed extreme-scale projects.

nsf-access.name: NSF ACCESS allocations
nsf-access.summary: Allocations on the cyberinfrastructure NSF ACCESS coordinates, in project types from small Explore projects to semi-annual Maximize requests.

nsf-nairr-pilot.name: NAIRR Pilot
nsf-nairr-pilot.summary: The National AI Research Resource Pilot: research, start-up and classroom allocations on AI computing resources from government and industry providers.
